name: Pizzeria Dobler
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Dobler in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Dobler** in the heart of **Tirol**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps. Our rustic stone oven pizzas, crafted with fresh, local ingredients, are baked to perfection—just like Nonna used to make them.

Try our signature **Tiroler Klassiker**: a crispy pizza base topped with creamy **Speck**, melted **Käse**, and a sprinkle of fresh **Salami**. For dessert, indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized, and served with a dollop of **Apfelmus** or a scoop of **Vanilleeis**.

Whether you're craving a quick lunch or a cozy dinner, **Pizzeria Dobler** in **Tirol** promises a taste of Italy with a touch of Alpine warmth. Come visit us in **Innsbruck**, **Kufstein**, or **Lienz**—your pizza adventure awaits!
